channel.desc: Add the stunning Set of 2 1914 & 1915 San Francisco Saint-Gaudens Gold Double Eagles in Mint State 64 condition to your numismatic collection. Of all 1914 and 1915-S Saint-Gaudens struck by the US Mint, less than 1% have been graded MS64.
